title: Breaking the System Noise Barrier at Exascale
problem: On exascale systems like El Capitan (1M+ CPU cores, 10K+ GPUs), OS and system services cause application interference, degrading performance and scalability
motivation: System noise at extreme scale directly impacts application performance; enabling scientific applications to leverage exascale hardware requires isolation strategies
method: Two-pronged strategy: (1) isolate system services from applications via cgroup/systemd tuning, (2) apply OS-level tuning to minimize application interference; distribution-independent guide provided
key_novelty: First comprehensive system noise characterization and mitigation for exascale systems; provides distribution-agnostic tuning strategies applicable to any Linux system
contributions: Characterization of system noise at exascale (El Capitan)
System service isolation techniques reducing interference
OS-level tuning guide for general Linux systems
limitations: Abstract-only analysis; specific performance improvements not quantified; strategies may be system-dependent despite claimed distribution independence
